title: Add details to project sales tooltip
summary: Project Sales by Project chart now displays project description and customer name in the tooltip alongside the project number to help users identify projects and customers without reducing visual readability.
key_points: Adds Project Description and Customer Name fields to the Power BI visual tooltip
Keeps Project No. as the compact chart axis to maintain readability
Leverages existing fields already present in the Sales semantic model
Enables users to cross-reference project and customer details within the tooltip
No changes to chart axis, measures, sorting, or filters
